query: Map a note app: capture a note and find a note, with two stories each.
inputs: activities: capture, find; stories under each
expected_behavior: emits a single well-formed svg using the svg-node vocabulary
puts the activities across the top and the stories in columns beneath
marks the walking-skeleton slice with a dashed line

query: Show which stories are in the first release versus later.
inputs: first slice: dictate text, keyword search; later: attach photo, filter by tag
expected_behavior: highlights the first-slice stories with a distinct accent
orders each column by priority with the essential story on top

query: The backlog has fifty stories; draw the story map.
expected_behavior: maps the activities that carry the argument rather than the whole backlog
